detail.longDescription: Supabase tip: turning on Row Level Security is only half the job. A policy written as using (true) lets anyone holding your public anon key read every row. Check: Authentication > Policies or the Security Advisor; look for policies whose condition is just true. Fix: use an owner rule like auth.uid() = user_id, then test as a second user. https:// abbilabs.xyz/tips/supabase-rls -using-true # Supabase # infosec # AppSec # webdev # vibecoding # nocode # Postgres # security # buildinpublic # cybersecurity # Cursor # SaaS # devtools
